track_backups_check_ignore: NOT_IGNORED (exit 1); target contents must NOT be copied into the repo-local track backups path
destination_safety_rationale: Backup root is beneath the resolved .git directory and therefore cannot be staged, committed, or diffed by the workspace repository; global skill/agent files are unversioned so a repo-tracked baseline is unavailable. The repo-local track backups path is NOT ignored, so it is prohibited as a backup destination. This location isolates backups from the worktree while remaining machine-local for verified restore.
